about_the_game:
Key Features

  • There are 2 different endings. We recommend experiencing both endings. (Hint below)

  • Estimated playtime: About 1 ~ 1.5 hours for first-time players.

  • Chapter save system supported.

Game Info

The familiar space filled with glowing monitors, the sound of mechanical keyboards, and the smell of instant noodles.
As a night-shift part-timer at a PC bang, your ordinary night slowly descends into unknown horror.

In this dark and dimly lit internet café, can you survive the night and make it to morning?

Features

Horror Hidden in the Ordinary:
Serve customers, clean up desks, prepare food — experience the realistic duties of a PC bang part-time job. But beware, your everyday actions may trigger dreadful events.

Explore the Darkened PC Bang:
Move freely through the counter, restrooms, smoking room, and every corner of the PC bang to uncover clues and approach the truth behind the strange phenomena.

Multiple Endings:
Your choices during the night shift will lead you to 2 different endings.

Controls

WASD - Move
Shift - Run
E - Interact
ESC - Options

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: First-person psychological horror game set in a Korean PC bang (Internet Cafe). Amid familiar part-time duties, strange phenomena slowly emerge, turning an ordinary night into a nightmare.
supported_languages:
English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean*, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, German, Indonesian, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
